description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink open-source test management tool. It handles the display and editing of execution notes within the web interface, initializing page components, retrieving execution data, and rendering a web editor for notes.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Generic PHP standard class used for constructing simple object instances.

methods.name: createExecNotesWebEditor
methods.description: Creates and returns HTML for the web editor used to edit execution notes, configuring its size and content.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns an object containing execution ID and readonly status from input parameters.
